'''Herds''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Crude Parasites|Crude]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawns after a [[Host]] gets 40 kills and evolves.
*Spawns in groups of 1 to 2, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]] onward, with a spawnweight of 5.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Herds are Melee/Ranged/Summoner Hybrids. They can move only when underground and are incapable of movement when on the surface.

While moving underground, they will release [[Residue]].

*Their Melee Attack, performed by slamming their large tentacles, inflicts knockback and AoE Damage.
*Their Ranged Attack is performed by them shooting Bombs in bursts of up to 2, which inflicts Poison, [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]], and [[Viral]] after exploding.
*Their Second Ranged Attack is performed by a poisonous Projectile being shot in bursts of up to 3 from the top of the Herd, this Projectile inflicts Poison for a short duration.
*They are able to perform summons, generating [[Mangler|Manglers]], while being underground.
*Herds are able to generate Waves, small damaging areas of disturbed ground. After standing still for a brief period they will summon a Wave which homes toward the target at fast speed but is unable to move up blocks. Waves deal very high damage per second and ignore immunity frames.
** This is telegraphed by flame particles and a significantly louder and higher pitched growl.
*They are able to teleport while underground, but the following conditions must be met:
**There must be 3 blocks below its current position, and in the position where it will teleport to.
**Those 3 blocks, in both positions, need to be full blocks.
**The sum of the 3 blocks' [[hardness]] values must be less than <u>15</u>.
* Upon death, if at least one [[Colony]] is present in the dimension, Herds will become [[Host|Hosts]].

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
*Herds, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
*Herds, while underground, can be damaged by other blocks like lava, fire, and magma.

== ''Trivia'' ==
*Herds are also known as '''Hostii''' in the Mod Files;
*According to the [[Compendium]], the tentacles of [[Host|Hosts]] and Herds have hollow openings at the end and possess the consistency of tar.
*Herds are said to be heard muttering, implying some for of intelligence, though nothing of these mutters has proven understanding.
